name: Lau ca dua
summary: Lẩu cá dứa nấu măng chua is the hotpot Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty. The fish has a smooth fatty skin. The broth is a southern sour-sweet pot with bamboo shoot already in it. You add bean sprouts, eggplant, pineapple, spring onion, and ngổ, then eat the fish with nước mắm, chili, and a little bún.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, places it on đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất in the old Cần Thạnh town, now xã Cần Giờ.
howToEat: Share the pot. When it boils, take a piece of fish into nước mắm with chili, and add bún and some of the broth.

The same story lists other pots beside it: lẩu cá ngát, cá bóp, cá mao, cá đuối, and cá chẽm, cooked with vegetables, sour bamboo, cần cà, or ngót. It does not print a separate method for cá ngát, cá bóp, or cá mao.
Dân Việt prints about 280,000–300,000 VND for a hotpot portion on 2 Oct 2022. A 2026 board was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Đường Duyên Hải, then đường Tắc Xuất toward the sea, in xã Cần Giờ. No shop is named. The hour is Check on arrival.
